Name: Briquid Mini
Description: A puzzle game about steering liquid: place and remove blocks until the water finds its way to where it has to go.

Achievements.Name: Break Stuff
Achievements.Description: Break a brick you just built.

Achievements.Name: A Good Start
Achievements.Description: Reach a score of 100% in the first twenty levels.

Achievements.Name: Halfway
Achievements.Description: Reach a score of 100% in fifty levels.

Achievements.Name: Almost Almost There
Achievements.Description: Reach a score of 100% in eighty levels.

Achievements.Name: Almost There
Achievements.Description: Reach a score of 100% in ninety levels.

Achievements.Name: Briquid Boss
Achievements.Description: Reach a score of 100% in all hundred levels.

Achievements.Name: Briquid Pro
Achievements.Description: Improve one of the level scores of the Gamious team.

Achievements.Name: Deliberate failure
Achievements.Description: Save 99% water in a level without solving it.
